mapper.select: SELECT SUM(T1.BID_PRIN_AMT) bidPrinAmt, group_concat(T1.BID_PRICE * 100 ,'%',',') bidPrice, T2.ENTRUST_DATE bidDate FROM ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID=T2.ENTRUST_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} GROUP BY (T2.ENTRUST_DATE)

SELECT T2.TRADER trader FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 INNER JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{bussBidDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND T3.Finprod_Market_Id = #{finprodMarketId} GROUP BY T2.TRADER

select group_concat(ea.DISPENSE_PARA,',') distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, er.VDATE vdate, er.MDATE mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{NOW()},'%Y-%m-%d') and er.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{NOW()},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE

select a.user_id userName,c.real_name realName,
regexp_replace(GROUP_CONCAT( d.asset_type order by d.asset_type SEPARATOR ','),'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') finprodType2 from sys_user_role a inner join sys_role b on a.role_id = b.role_id inner join sys_user c on a.user_id=c.user_name left join AUTO_DISPENSE_RIGHT d on a.user_id=d.user_id where b.role_pos = '06' group by a.user_id,c.real_name
